frames.narration: Someone edits the parental leave page in the wiki. The connector gets a change notice and puts an event on the queue with the document id, the new version and the access list that is on the page.

The indexer cuts the new version into 12 chunks along its headings and hashes each one. The old version had 13. Only 3 hashes differ from the stored ones, so only 3 chunks are embedded and replaced, 9 are untouched, and the 1 old chunk that no longer exists is deleted.
Later, an employee asks how many weeks of parental leave they get. The API authenticates them and asks the permission store for their groups: 41 of them, including all-staff and the Berlin office.

messages.label: how many weeks of parental leave?

frames.narration: Retrieval searches the keyword and the vector index at the same time, and both apply the 41 groups as a filter. Each returns 50 candidates, and rank fusion merges them into 72 distinct chunks. Salary bands and HR cases cannot appear because the filter removed them before ranking.

A cross-encoder reranker reads the question with each of the 72 chunks and keeps the best 6. A last check confirms against the live permission data that the user may still read all 6. The numbered passages come to about 2,900 tokens.

The API sends the question and the numbered passages to the model, which is told to answer only from them and to cite. The first words come back within 1.2 seconds and are streamed to the browser while the rest is still being written.

The API checks that the citations [1] and [3] are among the 6 passages it supplied, and shows them as links to the wiki page. The employee gives a thumbs up, which is stored with the question, the chunk ids and the versions, to be used later in evaluation.
